## Problem

What makes an AI-generated code change difficult to understand or maintain? Use a fictional example, not a private learning record.

## Desired outcome

What should a user be able to do? Give an example of how you'd check that the feature works. Include the coding agent and conversation language if relevant.

## Proposed change and alternatives

Describe a small possible improvement, any workaround, and whether it would require new permissions, external services, or runtime dependencies. A problem report is welcome even without a proposed implementation.

## Scope and privacy

Check the project boundaries in `docs/architecture.md`. Avoid real project source, account or organization identifiers, credentials, personal paths, and complete logs. Use `SECURITY.md` for a vulnerability rather than disclosing it here.
